submitDescription: Submitting freezes the lines and the costs. The adjustment can no longer be modified.
willRequireApproval: The total value exceeds the approval threshold: an approval will be required.
autoApproved: Below the threshold: the adjustment will be approved automatically on submission.
approveDescription: Approving this adjustment authorizes its validation and the stock decrease.
validateDescription: Validation decreases the stock. This action is irreversible.
cancelDescription: The adjustment will be marked as cancelled and can no longer be used.
deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this adjustment? This action is irreversible.
